app.name: Relance
app.tagline: Follow-up emails, written for each person

footer.local: Your contacts are stored only in this browser, on this computer. Relance never sends email: it writes drafts that you send yourself.

fields.fullName: Full name (split into first and last)

contacts.title: Contacts

empty.title: You don't have any contacts yet
empty.body: Import a spreadsheet of your contacts, or add them one at a time. To try Relance first, load a few made-up sample contacts.
empty.sampleHint: It shows which columns work well.

contacts.sampleAlreadyLoaded: The sample contacts are already in your list.
contacts.sampleError: The sample contacts could not be loaded. Check your internet connection and try again.
contacts.noNotesHint: Drafts for this contact can't be personal until you add notes.
contacts.saveFailed: That change couldn't be saved. Please try again.
contacts.deletedRecoverable_one: Deleted {{count}} contact. It stays in “Recently deleted” for 30 days.
contacts.deletedRecoverable_other: Deleted {{count}} contacts. They stay in “Recently deleted” for 30 days.

form.emailInvalid: This doesn't look like an email address.
form.languageHint: Automatic chooses the language from the country and your settings.
form.notesHint: The most important field. Write what you'd want to remember before emailing this person: what you talked about, what's happening for them, anything they mentioned.
form.serviceHistoryHint: What you've done together, if anything.
form.lastContactedHint: Leave empty if you've never been in touch.
form.saveFailed: The contact couldn't be saved. Please try again.
form.dateInvalid: Enter a full date, or leave it empty.
form.deletedElsewhere: This contact was deleted, possibly in another tab, so your changes couldn't be saved. You can restore it from “Recently deleted” on the Contacts page.
form.whereMetHint: For example: “Brussels HR forum, {{when}}”. The post-event template needs this.
form.openThreadHint: What you're waiting on, or never got back to. The re-engagement email is built around this. If it's empty, those drafts come back with a gap for you to fill in by hand.
form.openThreadPlaceholder: e.g. waiting on their budget decision; said they'd come back to us in the spring
form.addedNext: {{name}} is saved. Add the next contact, or close when you are done.

import.title: Import contacts from a spreadsheet
import.chooseIntro: Choose a CSV file. Most spreadsheet programs can save one:
import.howExcel: Excel: File → Save As → choose “CSV UTF-8”.
import.howSheets: Google Sheets: File → Download → Comma-separated values (.csv).
import.spreadsheetFile: This is a spreadsheet file, not a CSV file. Open it in your spreadsheet program, save it as CSV, then choose that file here.
import.readError: This file couldn't be read. Make sure it's a CSV file and try again.
import.emptyFile: This file has no rows to import.
import.mapIntro: Tell Relance what each column in your file contains. Where a column name was familiar, a choice has been filled in for you. Please check each one.
import.hasHeader: The first row contains column names
import.needName: To continue, choose which column holds first names (or full names).
import.missingName_one: {{count}} row has no first name and will be skipped.
import.missingName_other: {{count}} rows have no first name and will be skipped.
import.importFailed: The import didn't finish, and nothing was added. Please try again.
import.duplicates_one: {{count}} was already in your list (same email address) and was skipped.
import.duplicates_other: {{count}} were already in your list (same email address) and were skipped.
import.skippedName_one: {{count}} row had no first name and was skipped.
import.skippedName_other: {{count}} rows had no first name and were skipped.
import.unknownCountry_one: The country of {{count}} contact wasn't recognised, so it was left empty. You can set it by editing the contact.
import.unknownCountry_other: The country of {{count}} contacts wasn't recognised, so it was left empty. You can set it by editing each contact.
import.unknownDate_one: The last-contacted date of {{count}} contact couldn't be read, so it was left empty.
import.unknownDate_other: The last-contacted date of {{count}} contacts couldn't be read, so it was left empty.

storage.title: Relance can’t store your contacts in this browser
storage.body: Relance keeps everything on your own computer, inside the browser. This browser is currently not allowing that, which often happens in a private or incognito window.
storage.fix: Open this page in a normal browser window. If that doesn’t help, try another browser such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

create.title: Write emails
create.methodTemplate: Use the template text as it is
create.methodTemplateHint: Fills in names and your signature. No AI and no cost.
create.fallback_one: This template has no {{language}} version, so the {{fallback}} version will be used for {{count}} contact.
create.fallback_other: This template has no {{language}} version, so the {{fallback}} version will be used for {{count}} contacts.
create.noTemplates: There are no templates yet. You can add one in Settings.
create.failed: The drafts couldn't be created. Please try again.
create.methodAiHint: Uses each contact's notes. You review every email before anything is sent.
create.methodDemoHint: Shows how it works with drafts written in advance. Add an API key in Settings to write real ones.
create.estimate: About {{cost}} in AI costs for {{count}} emails. This is an estimate; the real cost is shown afterwards.
create.unavailable: None of these contacts has {{fields}} filled in, so this template can't be used. Add it on the contact first.
create.leftOut_one: {{count}} contact has nothing in {{fields}}, so this template won't be used for them. Fill it in on the contact to include them.
create.leftOut_other: {{count}} contacts have nothing in {{fields}}, so this template won't be used for them. Fill it in on each contact to include them.
create.willNeedOpenThread_one: {{count}} of these drafts will need finishing by hand: “Left open” is empty for that contact, so Relance will leave a gap rather than invent what was left open. Fill it in on the contact first for a complete draft.
create.willNeedOpenThread_other: {{count}} of these drafts will need finishing by hand: “Left open” is empty for those contacts, so Relance will leave a gap rather than invent what was left open. Fill it in on each contact first for complete drafts.

review.title: Review

empty.title: No drafts yet
empty.body: To write emails, select contacts on the Contacts page and choose “Write emails”, or see who is due on the Due now page.

review.subject: Subject
review.saveFailed: Not saved. Check that this page is still open, then type again.
review.unknownPlaceholders: This email still contains {{list}}. Replace it before sending.
review.noneApproved: Approve the drafts you want to send, then export them here.

errors.network: Couldn't reach the AI service, even after trying again three times. Check your internet connection, then click Try again.
errors.auth: Your API key was not accepted. Check it in Settings, then try again.
errors.rate_limit: The AI service is receiving too many requests. Relance waited and retried, but it is still busy. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.overloaded: The AI service is overloaded right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.malformed: The AI's answer came back incomplete twice. Try again. If it keeps happening, try a simpler instruction.
errors.billing: Your Anthropic account has run out of credit. Add credit on the Anthropic website, then try again.
errors.interrupted: Writing stopped because the page was closed or reloaded. Try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while writing this email. Try again.

payload.title: What was sent to the AI
payload.demoTitle: What would be sent to the AI
payload.note: This is everything that left your browser for this email. Nothing else was sent: not the surname, email address or phone number, and none of the fields you chose to withhold.
payload.demoNote: Demo mode: nothing was sent. This is exactly what would be sent if you added an API key.
payload.readable: Shown with the message text expanded so it is easier to read. Copy gives the exact text that was sent.

review.instructionPlaceholder: For example: shorter, mention the training, plus formel
review.needsInputTitle: Fill in the missing details before approving
review.needsInputBody: Relance didn't know {{list}}, so it left a placeholder instead of guessing. Replace it with the real detail. Until then, this email can't be approved or exported.
review.needsInputShort: Fill in the parts in [SQUARE BRACKETS] first.

export.title: Export approved drafts
export.eml: Email files for Outlook (.eml files in a .zip)
export.emlHint: Each draft opens in Outlook as a new email, ready for you to read and send.
export.brevoHint: One row per draft with email, first name, last name, subject and text, to import into a Brevo campaign.
export.noEmail_one: {{count}} draft has no email address. Add it in your email program before sending.
export.noEmail_other: {{count}} drafts have no email address. Add them in your email program before sending.
export.markContacted_one: Mark this contact as contacted today
export.markContacted_other: Mark these {{count}} contacts as contacted today
export.markContactedHint: Tick this only if you are sending these emails today. Relance uses this date to decide who is due next, so a wrong date quietly hides people from Due now.
export.doneEml: Find the .zip file in your Downloads folder and double-click it to open it. Then open each email file: Outlook shows it as a new message. Read it, then press Send.
export.doneBrevo: In Brevo, import this file as contacts. The SUBJECT and BODY columns become contact attributes that you can use in a campaign.
export.failed: The export didn't work. Please try again.
export.txt: Plain text files (.txt files in a .zip)
export.txtHint: One file per email, named after the contact, with the address and subject at the top. Use this if the email files don't open properly in your email program.
export.doneTxt: Find the .zip file in your Downloads folder and double-click it to open it. Open each text file, then copy the address, subject and text into a new email in your usual email program.

backup.title: Backup
backup.body: Your contacts are stored only in this browser. Browsers sometimes clear stored data, so download a backup now and then and keep it somewhere safe. The backup does not include your API key.
backup.failed: The backup couldn't be created. Please try again.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.merge: Add to what is already here
restore.mergeHint: Keeps your current contacts and settings, and adds anything from the backup that is missing.
restore.replaceHint: Your current contacts, drafts, templates and settings are replaced by the backup. Your API key is kept.
restore.notJson: This file isn't a Relance backup. Choose the .json file that you downloaded from Relance.
restore.notBackup: This file isn't a Relance backup, or it is damaged.
restore.tooNew: This backup was made by a newer version of Relance. Reload this page to get the latest version, then try again.
restore.failed: The restore didn't finish, and nothing was changed.

ai.title: AI connection
ai.body: Relance writes drafts with Claude, an AI made by Anthropic. It needs your own API key, which is stored only in this browser and sent only to Anthropic.
ai.keyHint: Starts with “sk-ant-”. Leave empty to use demo mode.
ai.guide: How to get an API key
ai.invalid: This key was not accepted. Check that you copied all of it.
ai.network: Couldn't reach Anthropic. Check your internet connection.
ai.empty: No key yet: Relance is in demo mode.

cost.title: AI costs
cost.hint: Worked out from what Anthropic reports for each draft.
cost.estimateNote: Costs are estimates. Anthropic charges in US dollars; Relance converts at a fixed rate of 1 USD = {{rate}} EUR. Your Anthropic account shows the exact amount.

you.title: Your details
you.body: Used to sign and complete your emails, on this computer only. None of this is sent to the AI: the drafts contain placeholders that are filled in here.
you.signatureHint: Added at the end of every email. If it is empty, your name is used.
you.calendlyHint: For example a Calendly link. Templates that mention it leave the line out when this is empty.
you.calendlyInvalid: This doesn't look like a web address. It should start with https://
you.gender: In French emails, words about you agree as
you.genderHint: French adjectives change with the writer (« ravi » or « ravie »). This only affects French emails. With neutral wording, Relance writes sentences that need no agreement.

languages.title: Email languages
languages.body: Each contact gets emails in their own language. You can set it on the contact; otherwise Relance decides from their country, using the choices below.
languages.builtIn: Contacts in France and Monaco get French unless you choose otherwise below.
languages.overridesHint: For example, if your contacts in Luxembourg or Belgium usually write in French.

privacy.title: What the AI sees
privacy.summary: Your contacts stay in this browser: Relance has no server, and the only thing it ever connects to is the AI service, when you ask it to write drafts. For each draft it sends only the fields ticked below, never surnames, email addresses or phone numbers, and every draft shows exactly what was sent.
privacy.sent: Sent to the AI when writing a draft
privacy.neverSent: Never sent: surname, email address, phone number, and your own details above.
privacy.notesWarning: If you untick notes, drafts can't mention anything specific about the person. They will be polite but generic.

voice.title: Your writing style
voice.body: Paste two or three emails you have written yourself. The AI copies your tone, sentence length, greetings and sign-offs, but never their content. They are sent with each draft, so remove names and private details first.
voice.empty: No examples yet. Drafts follow Relance's built-in tone: warm, short and without pressure.

compare.title: See what your examples change
compare.body: Relance writes the same email for one contact twice, once with your example emails and once without, and shows them side by side. Nothing is saved as a draft.
compare.cost: These two emails cost {{cost}}, added to your AI costs.
compare.variation: Any two drafts differ a little, so look at the tone, length, greeting and sign-off.
compare.confirmBody: Relance will write two emails for {{name}} with the AI, about {{cost}} in total. They are not saved as drafts.

unavailable.noSamples: Add at least one example email above first. Without one there is nothing to compare.
unavailable.noKey: This needs your API key. In demo mode the drafts are written in advance, so your examples can’t change them.
unavailable.noContacts: Add a contact first. The comparison writes an email for one of your contacts.
unavailable.noTemplate: None of your templates can be used for this contact.

danger.title: Delete everything
danger.body: Removes all contacts, drafts, templates and settings, including your API key, from this browser. Download a backup first if you might want them back.
danger.dialogBody: This removes all your contacts, drafts, templates and settings from this browser. It can't be undone.
danger.failed: Not everything could be deleted. Close other Relance tabs, then try again.

backupReminder.title: Time for a backup
backupReminder.body: You have {{count}} contacts stored only in this browser. Download a backup so you don't lose them if the browser clears its data.

demo.banner: Demo mode: drafts are examples written in advance, and no AI is used. To write real personalised emails, add your API key in Settings.

batch.waiting: The AI service asked Relance to slow down. It will retry automatically.
batch.failed_one: {{count}} couldn't be written; see the card for the reason.
batch.failed_other: {{count}} couldn't be written; see each card for the reason.
batch.authFailed: Your API key was not accepted, so Relance stopped. Check the key in Settings, then use Try again on each card.
batch.offline: You are offline, so Relance has paused. It will carry on by itself when the connection is back. Nothing is lost.
batch.needsInput_one: {{count}} draft needs your input: fill in the parts in [square brackets] before approving it.
batch.needsInput_other: {{count}} drafts need your input: fill in the parts in [square brackets] before approving them.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.note: Shortcuts are paused while you type in a field. Press Esc to leave the field first.

due.title: Due now
due.intro: People to follow up this month, based on each template's schedule. Tick the ones you want, then write the drafts.
due.rule: Sent in {{month}} to {{audience}} not contacted for at least {{days}} days.
due.alreadyDrafted: Already has a draft in Review
due.nothingNoneScheduled: Nobody is due in {{month}}: no template is scheduled this month.
due.nothingAllRecent: Nobody is due in {{month}}: everyone was contacted recently enough, or is missing a detail the template needs.
due.manualHintIdle: Nothing is scheduled right now, but you can write to anyone, with any template.
due.upcomingItem_one: {{name}} in {{month}}: {{count}} contact due as things stand
due.upcomingItem_other: {{name}} in {{month}}: {{count}} contacts due as things stand
due.manualHint: Pick any contacts and any template, whatever the schedule.
due.noContacts: Add contacts first. Nothing can be due without them.
due.ruleAll: Sent in {{month}} to everyone not contacted for at least {{days}} days.
due.willNeedOpenThread_one: {{count}} will need finishing by hand (“Left open” is empty)
due.willNeedOpenThread_other: {{count}} will need finishing by hand (“Left open” is empty)

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: The starting point for each kind of email. With AI, each email is written fresh from the purpose and the brief; the email text is only used when you choose not to use AI.
templates.restoredNone: All built-in templates are already here.
templates.scheduleNone: Never on its own (I choose the contacts)
templates.gap: Only if not contacted for at least
templates.appliesToHint: Leave all unticked to include everyone.
templates.name: Name
templates.subject: Subject
templates.bodyLabel: Email text (used as it is without AI; never shown to the AI)
templates.instructionsHint: What the email must achieve, what it must contain, and what it must not. Describe content, not wording: the AI writes each email in its own words from the contact's details.
templates.placeholdersHint: Placeholders are replaced with real details on this computer. Keep the double curly brackets.
templates.unknown: Relance doesn't know {{list}}. It will appear as it is in the email.
templates.needVersion: Give at least one version a name and some email text.
templates.empty: There are no templates. Restore the built-in ones or create a new one.
templates.purposeHint: One sentence about the job this email does that your other templates don't. The AI uses it to keep each kind of email distinct.
templates.requires: Only for contacts that have at least one of
templates.requiresHint: Leave all unticked to allow everyone. For example, the post-event email needs “Where you met”, and re-engagement needs something to pick up again.

welcome.title: Welcome to Relance
welcome.lead: Relance helps you write personal follow-up emails to the people you work with, at the right time of year.
welcome.does1: It suggests who to get back in touch with, based on when you last wrote.
welcome.does2: It writes a draft for each person, using your notes about them, in their language.
welcome.does3: You read and edit every draft, then send it yourself from your usual email program.
welcome.never: Relance never sends email. It has no way to.
welcome.local: Your contacts stay in this browser, on this computer. There is no account and no server.

key.title: Connect the AI (optional)
key.body: To write personal drafts, Relance uses Claude, an AI by Anthropic. You need your own API key. It costs less than one euro cent per email, and the key stays in this browser.
key.guide: Step-by-step guide to getting a key
key.later: You can skip this. Relance then runs in demo mode, with example drafts, and you can add a key later in Settings.

contacts.title: Add your contacts
contacts.body: Import a spreadsheet of your contacts, or try Relance first with a few made-up people.

crash.title: Something went wrong on this screen
crash.body: Your contacts and drafts are safe: they are stored in this browser and were not affected. Reloading the page usually fixes this.

trash.title: Recently deleted
trash.body: Contacts you delete are kept here for {{days}} days, whichever tab or window deleted them, then removed for good.
trash.emptied: Recently deleted contacts removed for good.

tabs.notice: Relance is also open in another tab or window of this browser. Both show the same contacts and stay in step, so a change or deletion in one appears in the other.

help.label: More about “{{topic}}”
help.leftOpen: Write the one thing still unresolved between you, such as a question they asked or a decision they were weighing. The re-engagement email is built around it, so it can pick up the conversation where it stopped.
help.whatAiSees: For each draft, the AI receives only the ticked fields, for that one contact. Surnames, email addresses and phone numbers never leave this computer, whatever you tick.
help.languageAuto: “(auto)” means Relance chose the language from the contact’s country: French for France and Monaco, otherwise your choice in Settings → Email languages. Pick a language in this column to set it yourself.
help.markContacted: Relance counts from this date to decide when someone is due again. If you send later, leave this unticked and change “Last contacted” on the Contacts page on the day you send.
